subject: phase3_dvc_medium_calibration
statement: Replace the zero-call DVC bundle with a runtime that scopes official-evaluator candidates to the frozen single-instance selection.
selected_option: bind a new immutable release at c470610d5814d17935b64d07b9e05a0fe3cab915 and rebuild every runtime-dependent authority before launch

alternatives.option: supply unselected Requests and Dask source mirrors to the evaluator
alternatives.rejected_reason: Those instances are outside the frozen DVC execution selection and would weaken exact source-coverage validation.
The evaluator must retain exact source coverage for every active candidate; the defect was the active candidate set, not the coverage rule.
Provider-free initialization proved that bundle could not construct its evaluator, so no paid execution may use it.

rationale: The candidate authority intentionally contains all three originally selected benchmark instances, while this calibration selects only DVC. The live runner incorrectly passed the complete authority map into a single-instance evaluator. The repair projects candidates through bundle.ordered_instance_ids and fails closed when a selected ID is absent. Fifty-eight focused tests and the complete 1218-test provider-free suite passed with seven skips. No model invocation was admitted before the defect was found.
expected_outcome: A rebuilt bundle initializes a single-instance evaluator with exact DVC source coverage, after which the unchanged bounded three-mode calibration may launch.
acceptance_refs: complete provider-free suite: 1218 passed and 7 skipped
release phase3-calibration-c470610 matches the tested source files
a zero-execution live initialization completes with resource cleanup
all task, model, mode-order, public-environment, and budget fields remain unchanged
